candidates.change_summary: Removed the hasNoBalance modifier invocation from airDrop so callers with existing balances can receive more tokens.
Changed the reentrancy guard to not reset _locked to false after function execution, causing future calls to be blocked and potentially changing balances observed after subsequent calls.
Modified supportsToken to compare against a different string, causing supportsToken() check to fail for callers returning the original value and preventing airDrop from succeeding.
Changed hasNoBalance to require the caller already has a positive balance, allowing only existing holders to receive the airdrop and changing tokenBalance outcomes for some keys.
Removed the hasNoBalance modifier from airDrop so callers with nonzero balance can receive additional tokens.
Changed the increment from 20 to 40 so airDrop grants a different amount of tokens.
Removed resetting _locked to false after function execution, causing _locked to remain true and preventing subsequent airDrop calls, changing observed behavior after calls.
Relaxed hasNoBalance to allow balances <= 10 instead of exactly 0, changing which callers can successfully call airDrop.
Made supportsToken compare against a different string so valid callers (Bank) no longer pass the check, preventing airDrop from succeeding.
